connections.why: Technical command is the foundation of a controlled solo performance
Stylistic interpretation shapes how the solo performance communicates
The viva voce reflects on decisions made in the solo performance
Effective harmony underpins the Option A composition
Harmonic technique is needed in the technology-based composition too
Handling instrumental and textural resources gives the composition its sound
The composition must be presented through notation and a commentary
Technology-based work is documented through presentation and commentary
Hearing musical elements is the basis for identifying genres and forms
Knowledge of forms supports analysis of orchestral set works
Understanding vocal genres supports study of sacred vocal works
Genre knowledge frames analysis of secular vocal music
Composing with harmony deepens aural recognition of harmonic features
Analysing harmony in set works models techniques used when composing
Studying orchestral scoring informs use of instrumental resources in composition
Aural and analytical awareness sharpens interpretation in performance
